bagPolicy.summary: EagleBank Arena has a clear bag policy to enhance the contactless experience. Bags must be clear and not exceed 12”x12”x6”, with exceptions for small clutches and medical or parenting bags.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12”x12”x6”
1 gallon plastic zip lock style bags
Non-clear clutch style bags or purses up to 5”x7”
bagPolicy.note: Small medical and/or parenting bags are permitted on a case-by-case basis and subject to increased security screening.

parking.note: Parking areas surrounding EagleBank Arena are available for event parking three hours prior to the event start time. A parking fee is included in the ticket price, and there is ample parking on the campus. Accessible parking is available for patrons with disabilities adjacent to the South Entry.

rideshare.note: Use the South entrance for accessible passenger drop-off.

concessions.note: EagleBank Arena offers a variety of food options including specialty burgers, chicken tenders, BBQ, and plant-based items like the BEYOND Burger and Sausage. Concessions are staffed by volunteers, and payments can be made with cash, credit cards, or Mason Money Loyalty Cards.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is available for all events. Sign language interpretation must be requested 14 days before the event through the Accessible Seating line at 703-993-3035, assistive listening headsets are first-come, first-served at Guest Services, and any team member can arrange a wheelchair escort when you arrive. Trained service dogs are welcome; comfort animals are not.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For George Mason Basketball games, the pass gate or press entrance for the media is located at the West entrance, to the left of the box office when you are facing the building. Check the Box Office page for current box office hours.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For general admission events, doors typically open 90 minutes before start time, and floor GA ticket holders gather and enter at the North entrance. The Box Office is at the West Entrance.
